rows.label: Bhaira Model
rows.note: on her own prebuilt Hound, or as her random component blueprint
rows.alt: trade for the blueprint from another player if RNG stalls

conditions: Vanquish, never convert: a converted Sister hands over no Hound and no component blueprint.
Her Hound's Model is rolled when she is created, one of three.
A Parazon Mercy on the downed Candidate is what creates the Sister in the first place.
The Treasurer escapes if you take too long, and a crown is spent on every Granum Void entry.
bonuses: Each vanquish also hands over her Tenet weapon, whatever Model her Hound carries.
If her Hound isn't Bhaira, the random component blueprint she drops is tradeable and can still go toward a Bhaira Model build.
Every squad member who vanquishes with her gets a random Hound component blueprint.

disclosures.title: the fast Sister loop
disclosures.body: Solo, normal, not Steel Path, Capture on Hydra, Pluto. A squad raises the kill requirement inside the Granum Void by 25 per player, so run it alone. Waypoint a Golden Hand Tribute first, kill the capture target, then come back and offer the Zenith crown; if no Tribute has shown up halfway through the tile, restart, and a Tribute within roughly 200m of extraction can mean the Candidate never spawns. Inside the Void, Xoris heavy attacks charge it; detonating it on a captive Solaris adds 20 seconds, and Specter Particles add 5. Kill the Treasurer every cycle for the next crown, and hit Replay on the end screen to re-run.

disclosures.title: you don't need to build one
disclosures.body: The prebuilt Hound a vanquished Sister leaves in your Foundry works exactly like one you build, including for Mastery once gilded. Check which Model each new Sister's Hound carries before committing to the fight. If you build from a dropped blueprint, the Bhaira Model costs 50,000 credits, 5 Spectral Debris, 5 Gallium, 2 Marquise Thyst and 10 Eye-Eye Rotoblades over 24h, and you still need a Core, Bracket and Stabilizer, each its own Sister blueprint drop.

conditions: Claiming needs two free Companion slots: one for the Hound and one for its Lacerten.
Check the Model before selling an unclaimed Hound for 20,000 credits.

rows.label: Bhaira Hound, gilded
rows.note: and its Lacerten; 10 Training Debt-Bonds, 5,000 standing

conditions: Level the Hound to rank 30 first. Gilding resets it to rank 0, and the Model's Mastery counts from the second climb.
An ungilded Hound earns no Mastery for its Model.
Mastery is per Model: once a gilded Hound with this Model hits 30, later ones with it give none.
bonuses: The Lacerten is its own Mastery entry on top of the Model.
